name: Chrome Hearts Black Leather Cross Patch Fleur Pants
basis_of_authenticity: Dealer listing: sold as authentic by Savonches. No outside legit check; the basis is the dealer only.
model: Black leather, cross patches, fleur knee. Our earlier note of this listing: 12 patches, described by the dealer as a V.I.P custom order with wash tags missing.
what_the_tags_read: Leather label: embossed scroll, CHROME HEARTS in gothic letters, "U.S.A." in plain capitals under it. Stitched all round. The cut edge has worn to brown.
Tab under the label: worn to a frayed brown stub, no text legible.
No fabric wash or size tag appears in the listing photos.
Lining: fabric with tone-on-tone emblems (the photo has a yellow-green colour cast).
